# WaitJI AI — llms.txt
# https://www.waitjiai.in

WaitJI AI is India's first AI advertising marketplace for VS Code developers, operated by QivaLabs LLP (LLPIN: ACV-6746, DPIIT: DIPP247112), Udaipur, Rajasthan, India.

## What it does
- Developers install a free VS Code extension that shows one sponsored ad during Claude Code's "Thinking..." state
- Developers earn 50% of ad revenue, paid directly to their UPI account
- Advertisers bid on two placements: Spotlight (₹800/1,000 impressions, VS Code spinner) and Stream (₹300/1,000 impressions, terminal status line)
- Both auctions run independently with live bidding

## Key facts
- Extension: WaitJiai.waitji-ai on VS Code Marketplace
- Only works with Claude Code (Anthropic) inside VS Code
- Uses officially documented spinnerVerbs and statusLine settings — no file patching
- Minimum developer withdrawal: ₹100 to verified UPI or bank account
- Fraud detection built-in; invalid clicks not billed to advertisers
